title: After the Arima Kinen: Their Voices

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin wins first place at the Arima Kinen, and her family and friends celebrate like there's no tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But it's not just Ines's fans who are moved by the sight of her chasing her dreams. Oguri Cap—who was rumored to be retiring—is also inspired to hope again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines's running isn't a selfish act at all—it's the very embodiment of everyone's dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Realizing that it's okay for her to run as much as she wants, and to enjoy it too, Ines wells up. It's not long before her cheeks are glistening with warm tears.
